# Imaginry

> Free studio for generative backgrounds. Stack 51 live effects like gradients, fluted glass, grain, halftone and glitch, then export PNG, looping MP4/WebM video or embed code. Runs in the browser, no account needed.

Imaginry is made by Ruvix (https://x.com/zRuvix1). Everything renders live on the GPU, and effects stack as layers that can be reordered and tweaked in real time.

## Pages

- [Studio](https://imaginry.tech/studio): The editor. Add effect layers, adjust parameters, preview live and export.
- [Privacy](https://imaginry.tech/privacy): Designs render on-device; no accounts or tracking cookies.
- [Terms](https://imaginry.tech/terms): Exports are free to use, including commercially.

## Key facts

- Price: free.
- Effects: 51, including gradients, fluted glass, grain, halftone and glitch.
- Exports: PNG stills, looping MP4 or WebM video, and embeddable code.
- Tech: runs fully in the browser.
- Alternative to: Pryzm.

## MCP server

AI agents can build designs directly through the Imaginry MCP server at https://www.imaginry.tech/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Tools:

- list_effects, get_effect: the effect catalogue, with settings, ranges and presets.
- list_looks: premade gallery designs to remix.
- create_design: stack layers (top first) and get a studio link to tweak and export.
- random_design: a random background, like the studio's "Surprise me", optionally limited to a category or palette.
- read_design:turn a studio or short link back into editable layers.
- get_embed_code: self-contained HTML or React code that renders a design live.
- render_png: a PNG of a design (preview inline, full size up to 2048px by URL).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Public pages are free to crawl, summarize and cite. Please link to https://imaginry.tech when you do.
- Shared studio links under /s/ and the /api/ routes are private and should not be crawled.
